items.title: AI-capex concentration
items.detail: Index gains still lean on a handful of mega-cap AI names funding each other's capex. AMD (+107% data-center) and PLTR (+29%) show the theme is intact, but any crack in the loop drags the whole tape.

items.title: July jobs report Fri Aug 7
items.detail: Consensus ~87.5K. A soft print revives Sahm-rule/labor-cooling worries; a hot one hardens the Fed's no-cut stance. Biggest near-term swing factor.

items.title: Hawkish Fed split
items.detail: The Jul 29 hold was 9-3 with three dissents FOR a hike; sticky inflation keeps cuts off the table and rate risk two-sided at 3.50-3.75%.

items.title: Rotation / narrow leadership
items.detail: Aug 5 saw mega-cap tech give back while Dow set a record - money rotating into industrials/materials/energy. Healthy breadth, but a leadership handoff can be choppy.

items.title: Tariff overhang
items.detail: Early-August tariff headlines on major exporters remain a slow-burn margin/supply-chain risk into the back half of earnings season.

items.title: Volatility complacency
items.detail: VIX 15.81 into a jobs-report Friday leaves little cushion if the print or tariffs disappoint.

items.title: Oil easing
items.detail: Brent ~$79 (down from ~$88) on Hormuz shipping hopes - a mild disinflation tailwind but a headwind for energy names.
